mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorite (user_id, product_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, b.name AS brand_name FROM user_favorite uf JOIN product p ON uf.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
